rationale: learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=12, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_hidden=32, lpd_share_weights=False, epochs=10, lr=0.0012, lr_schedule=cosine, batch_size=1, grad_clip=0.5, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, rationale=iter-8 one-knob: grad_clip 1.0->0.5 at the BEST config (iter-6: I12/h32/ep10/lr1.2e-3, hr=0.6685). If this TIMEOUTs I will re-dispatch at I=11.
